This application is filed seeking an urgent hearing 
of the Writ Petition. The Writ Petition relates to the year 
2016. Writ Petitions relating to the year 2014 and prior 
thereto are slated for an out of turn hearing and are listed 
every Wednesday and Thursday. As several of these 
Writ Petitions are still pending on the file of this Court, 
suffice it to direct that the hearing of this Writ Petition, 
which relates to the year 2016, be expedited. 
Urgency application is, accordingly, disposed of.
